_comment: Declarative Test Matrix: separates test thresholds/scenarios from Python code (like YAML in pytest CI pipelines).

functional_smoke.description: Verify valid head-nod gesture wakes AP and idle/noise does not.

stress_high_rate.description: High-frequency 400Hz IMU stress test to catch FIFO/buffer drops.

fault_demo_dsp_throttle.description: Simulated thermal/clock throttling on DSP causing P95 latency regression.

fault_demo_fifo_overflow.description: Simulated sensor driver bug causing IMU FIFO overflow and dropped samples.
